name: Atul Ltd
about: Atul Ltd. is a diversified and integrated Indian chemical company (a part of Lalbhai Group, Gujarat). The products of the company are used in various Industries and come mainly under two segments, Life Science Chemicals and Performance and Other Chemicals under 9 Businesses. [1]Since its incorporation, the company has manufactured many products for the first time in India Dyes including Vat Dyes, crop care chemicals, Phosgene, Carbamite, 2,4-D Acid, para Cresol, tissue culture raised date palms. [2]
keyPoints:
History
The company is a part of Lalbhai Group, one of the oldest business houses in India and the first company in India inaugurated by the first Prime Minister. It was originally promoted by Padma Bhushan late Kasturbhai Lalbhai in 1947 as Atul Products Ltd and was later renamed Atul Ltd in 1996. It has followed the B2B model since inception, it has now also ventured into B2C products. [1] [2]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 17.4%
cons: Stock is trading at 2.97 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.41% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.07% over last 3 years.
